items.readable_text:
Content:
Suppose that we want to know the values of [MATH: x] and [MATH: y] that satisfy both of the equations
[MATH: {x − y = − 4; 6x − y = 6.]

Content:
We call this a system of linear equations. The equations of the system define two straight lines, so we can visualize the system by plotting both lines on the same graph.

Graphic:
[IMG: /graphics/1fcd2474e0221ed265f2df50bb55e17a]

Content:
The solution of the system corresponds to the point where the two lines intersect. In this case, it is the point [MATH: (2,6)], as shown above. So [MATH: x=2] and [MATH: y=6] form the solution to the system. We can write the solution as the ordered pair [MATH: (2, 6).]

Content:
Whenever we find a solution to a system of equations, it is a good idea to double-check our result. To check that the solution [MATH: x=2,y=6] is the correct solution, we substitute our solution into both of the equations.

Content:
Let's check the first equation.

Content:
[MATH: x − y|=− 4; (2) − (6)|= − 4; − 4|= − 4✓]

Content:
Now we check the second equation:
[MATH: 6x − y|=6; 6(2) − 6|= 6; 6|= 6✓]

Content:
Since [MATH: x=2] and [MATH: y=6] satisfied both equations, it is indeed the solution to the system of equations.

Graphic:
[IMG: /graphics/1fcd2474e0221ed265f2df50bb55e17a]

Content:
The solution of the system corresponds to the point where the two lines intersect. In this case, it is the point [MATH: (2,6)], as shown above. So [MATH: x=2] and [MATH: y=6] form the solution to the system. We can write the solution as the ordered pair [MATH: (2, 6).]

Content:
Whenever we find a solution to a system of equations, it is a good idea to double-check our result. To check that the solution [MATH: x=2,y=6] is the correct solution, we substitute our solution into both of the equations.

Let's check the first equation.

[MATH: x − y|=− 4; (2) − (6)|= − 4; − 4|= − 4✓]

Content:
Now we check the second equation:
[MATH: 6x − y|=6; 6(2) − 6|= 6; 6|= 6✓]

Content:
Since [MATH: x=2] and [MATH: y=6] satisfied both equations, it is indeed the solution to the system of equations.
